operation_row_ledger.merge_ready_rule: Every open operation row has merge_ready_enabled=false; runtime CLI reachability is recorded independently and is never rewritten as disabled or not-applicable.

cmd/connectorgen/validate.go:696-721 repeats the REST operation coverage restriction.

evidence: internal/connectors/engine/read.go:771-785 resolves write query templates through the shared optional-query helper, while :1338-1348 treats only config, secrets, and incremental references as omittable.

The documented Zoom Delete a meeting action declares occurrence_id as an optional record-derived query input. The lane-owned fixture fails before I/O when a regular meeting correctly has no occurrence_id.
gaps.minimal_change: Permit buildWriteQuery to omit only an unresolved exact record reference when its query entry explicitly sets omit_when_absent and that record path is declared by the action's source-locked record_schema; keep every other missing or invalid input a hard pre-I/O error.

gaps.minimal_change: Project a connector-owned direct-operation fixture and conformance assertion to the matching operation kind, retaining exact command/operation identity rather than treating a stream fixture as generic operation evidence.

gaps.minimal_change: Replace the wave0 constant stage with a connector-neutral declaration-fixture conformance runner over defs.FS; pass only when the declared connector fixtures execute, and retain an explicit unavailable result where no fixture contract exists.

evidence: internal/connectors/certify/stages_source.go:673-695 runs every stream's read, flow, and schedule lifecycle in a full sweep; Zoom's entitled users and meetings stages pass while Webinar is a paid-tier refusal.

internal/connectors/certify/stages_source.go:431 makes Report.Passed depend on every stage, and external evidence import accepts only a passing report. The successful bounded source stages therefore cannot publish a capability:read proof with their already-passing fixtures.
gaps.minimal_change: Preserve all-or-nothing full-report and full-parity semantics, but publish a separately keyed, fingerprint-only capability-stage evidence record only when that exact declared stream, fixture contract, and bounded live stage passed; unrelated stream refusals must remain visible and cannot promote a broader connector claim.

evidence: internal/connectors/certify/stages_source.go:690-694 runs flow and schedule round-trips for every full-sweep source stream.

Zoom declares a narrow source/destination pair, but has no declared flow fixture or schedule round-trip contract; its full run must record that absent optional surface as non-applicable instead of attempting schedule creation.
gaps.minimal_change: When a connector lacks a declared executable flow fixture or schedule contract, mark flow and schedule round-trip stages non-applicable before invoking schedule creation; retain failures for connectors that do declare the required surface.
